LanguageData.SpecialPawnNeiyu.label: Neiyu Angelite
LanguageData.SpecialPawnNeiyu.desc:
A Milira born and raised in the fires of war, driven to seek power and master the laws that shape the world. She led her people in exile to rise anew from the flames, only to become a pawn in someone else's hands. A fragment, a sliver of will. Through everything she has endured, one wish remains: to become an immortal again.
From Milira Character Expansion — Neiyu
